title: Glasshouse
caption: Silver Street Productions x CAIAC, 2026
logline: A boundary-pushing mocku-theatre piece: a stubborn bus driver, a houseless man who can't afford a ticket, and a repugnant dilemma for the passengers between them.
synopsis: On a night of unrelenting rain and flooding in the British countryside, a standoff between a stubborn bus driver and a houseless man who can't afford a ticket slides into a mire of tension and social conflict — bringing the passengers to a repugnant dilemma. Adapted from the stage play by Charlie McGuire, Glasshouse explores the human beast with unwavering intimacy through pre-recorded interviews with its 'real-life' characters, in which they share their renditions of what happened on the night of February 14th, 2011.
